title: Who Should We Listen to More? Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition for Pluralistic Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.19035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pluralistic alignment needs to accommodate diverse preferences under limited human feedback. Using AI simulators to label preference comparisons reduces annotation costs, but variation in simulation accuracy across individuals can leave some people's preferences poorly represented in training. We study how to allocate human feedback across people to construct training data for pluralistic alignment, and how this allocation affects the trained policy. To make this allocation explicit and controllable, we define a social welfare objective over individual supervision utilities that measure label quality. Each query's marginal welfare gain depends on its expected supervision improvement, the recipient's current utility, and application-designated priority. translated_title: 我们应该更多地倾听谁的声音？面向多元对齐的福利感知偏好获取
translated_abstract: 多元对齐需要在有限的人类反馈下容纳多样化的偏好。使用AI模拟器来标注偏好比较可以降低标注成本，但不同个体之间模拟精度的差异可能导致某些人的偏好在训练中代表性不足。我们研究了如何在人群之间分配人类反馈以构建多元对齐的训练数据，以及这种分配如何影响训练得到的策略。为了使这种分配明确且可控，我们定义了一个基于个体监督效用的社会福祉目标，该效用衡量标注质量。每个查询的边际福祉增益取决于其预期的监督改进、接收者的当前效用以及应用指定的优先级。福利感知偏好获取（WAPA）使用辅助参考模型来估计查询增益和个体效用，然后根据估计的边际福祉增益来选择查询……
tldr: 提出福利感知偏好获取（WAPA）方法，通过基于个体监督效用的社会福祉目标在人群中分配有限的人类反馈，解决多元对齐中因AI模拟精度差异导致的偏好代表性不足问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition (WAPA), which allocates limited human feedback across individuals by maximizing a social welfare objective over supervision utilities, addressing the problem that variation in AI simulation accuracy can leave some people's preferences poorly represented in pluralistic alignment training.
